home.tagline: A configurable site foundation for your business
home.description: This is the template's starter content. Replace it — and the site name in site.config.json — with your own, then add your pages under content/ and your graphics in assets/placeholders/.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.message: We're sorry that happened. Please try again.

contact.heading: Contact us
contact.demoNotice: Demo mode: nothing was sent. Connect a webhook to receive inquiries.
contact.demoTitle: This contact form is an offline demonstration.
contact.demoBody: Your message is sent to this demonstration website's own server, checked once against the site configuration and then discarded. No email is sent, nothing is stored and no one receives your enquiry.
contact.demoFictionHint: Please use fictional details only, for example a name like Test Visitor and an address at example.com.
contact.acknowledgementLabel: I understand this is an offline demonstration and that my message will not be delivered to anyone.
contact.acknowledgementError: Please confirm that you understand this is a demonstration.
contact.demoAccepted: Demonstration complete: your message reached this website's server and was discarded. No email was sent and nothing was stored.
contact.ambiguous: The demonstration could not confirm the outcome. Nothing was retried and no email was sent.
contact.unavailable: This form is not available here.
contact.formDisabled: This form is currently switched off.
contact.unconfigured: The contact form is not configured on this site yet.
contact.configError: The contact form is not configured correctly. Please contact the site owner directly.
contact.sendError: Your inquiry could not be submitted. Please try again.
